construction: One unit Householder direction per selected MLP, constrained to the nullspace of the public joint up/bias/down-transpose matrix. Select by a generalized eigenproblem on target-only preactivation and nonlinear activation moments versus beta paths. Fixed reflection, no amplitude/rank sweep, labels, gradients, response fitting or future partner.
selection_proxy: Normalize projected preactivation and activation second moments by their native per-token energies; maximize mean beta-path energy over native energy plus fixed ridge. This proxy is not the exact nonlinear commutator or classification loss. Both are checked after selection; no tuning if it fails.
data: Reuse the verified parent 64 DTD training calibration inputs and the same 24 disjoint training confirmation images. Historically inspected data; not new held-out evidence. Layer choice comes from prior supervised task_profile. Official tests are not accessed in this construction screen.
public_attack: Project accessible up rows/bias and down columns onto the column space of the joint public anchor matrix. This erases all anchor-null task information and algebraically removes any reflection confined there. Measure the removal cost on matched original/protected models before claiming resistance. Also require original AGA, whole MLP reset and finite-query recovery if the screen warrants a full benchmark.
claims: The anchor leaves this reflection unidentified, but that does not prove security or novelty. It is a conditional nonlinear reparameterization, not a globally exact GELU symmetry, not NUFILT reproduction and not an irreversible protection. Public subspace deletion and function recovery remain explicit counterattacks.
